camel_example: aliyun esa CreateWaitingRoomEvent --region cn-hangzhou --SiteId 1234560000 --JsonResponseEnable on --Description test --WaitingRoomType default --EndTime 1719849600 --DisableSessionRenewalEnable on --PreQueueStartTime 1719763200 --StartTime 1719763200 --RandomPreQueueEnable on --QueuingStatusCode 202 --CustomPageHtml 'SGVsbG8gd29ybGQ=' --Name waitingroom_example --NewUsersPerMinute 10 --SessionDuration 5 --Language zhcn --PreQueueEnable on --TotalActiveUsers 100 --Enable on --WaitingRoomId 6a51d5bc6460887abd1291dc7d4db28b --QueuingMethod random
description_en: Creates a waiting room event. You can specify the queuing method and type
description_zh: 创建等候室事件，可以选择排队方式以及类型等
kebab_example: aliyun esa create-waiting-room-event --site-id 1234560000 --waiting-room-id 6a51d5bc6460887abd1291dc7d4db28b --enable on --name waitingroom_example --total-active-users 100 --new-users-per-minute 10 --session-duration 5 --disable-session-renewal-enable on --queuing-method random --queuing-status-code 202 --json-response-enable on --description test --waiting-room-type default --custom-page-html SGVsbG8gd29ybGQ= --start-time 1719763200 --end-time 1719849600 --pre-queue-enable on --pre-queue-start-time 1719763200 --random-pre-queue-enable on --biz-language zhcn --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateWaitingRoomEvent

parameters.help_en: The site ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2850189.html operation to obtain the site ID
parameters.help_zh: 站点ID，可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2850189.html接口获取
parameters.name: site_id

parameters.help_en: The waiting room ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2850279.html operation to obtain the waiting room ID. The waiting room must belong to the site specified by SiteId
parameters.help_zh: 等候室ID，可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2850279.html接口获取，且必须属于请求 SiteId 对应站点下已有的等候室
parameters.name: waiting_room_id

parameters.help_en:
The waiting room switch. Valid values:

- **on**: enabled.
- **off**: disabled
parameters.help_zh:
等候室开关。取值：

- **on**：开启。
- **off**：关闭
parameters.name: enable

parameters.help_en: The name of the waiting room event
parameters.help_zh: 等候室事件名称
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The total number of active users
parameters.help_zh: 活跃用户总数
parameters.name: total_active_users

parameters.help_en: The number of new users per minute
parameters.help_zh: 每分钟新用户数
parameters.name: new_users_per_minute

parameters.help_en: The session duration, in minutes
parameters.help_zh: 会话持续时间，单位是分钟
parameters.name: session_duration

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to disable session renewal. Valid values:

- **on**: enabled.
- **off**: disabled
parameters.help_zh:
禁用会话续订。取值：

- **on**：开启。
- **off**：关闭
parameters.name: disable_session_renewal_enable

parameters.help_en:
The queuing method. Valid values:

- **random**: random.
- **fifo**: first-in, first-out.
- **passthrough**: passthrough.
- **reject-all**: reject all
parameters.help_zh:
排队方式。取值：

- **random**：随机。
- **fifo**：先进先出。
- **passthrough**：直通。
- **reject-all**：拒绝全部
parameters.name: queuing_method

parameters.help_en:
The waiting room status code. Valid values:

- **200**
- **202**
- **429**
parameters.name: queuing_status_code

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable JSON response. When enabled, requests with an Accept header containing "application/json" return JSON data. Valid values:

- **on**: enabled.
- **off**: disabled
parameters.help_zh:
JSON响应。开启后accept请求头包含"application/json"会返回JSON数据。取值：

- **on**：开启。
- **off**：关闭
parameters.name: json_response_enable

parameters.help_en: The description of the waiting room
parameters.help_zh: 等候室描述
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
The type of the waiting room. Valid values:

- **default**: default type.
- **custom**: custom type
parameters.help_zh:
等候室类型。支持以下类型：

- **default**：默认类型。
- **custom**：自定义类型
parameters.name: waiting_room_type

parameters.help_en: The custom waiting room page content. This parameter is required when the waiting room type is set to custom. The content must use Base64 encoding
parameters.help_zh: 用户自定义等候室页面内容，当等候室类型为自定义类型时，需要传入。传入的内容需要经过base64编码
parameters.name: custom_page_html

parameters.help_en: The event start timestamp, such as 1705044735
parameters.help_zh: 事件开始时间戳，格式如：1705044735
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The event end timestamp, such as 1705044735
parameters.help_zh: 事件结束时间戳，格式如：1705044735
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable pre-queuing. Valid values:

- **on**: enabled.
- **off**: disabled
parameters.help_zh:
预排队开关。

- **on**：开启。
- **off**：关闭
parameters.name: pre_queue_enable

parameters.help_en: The pre-queuing start timestamp, which must be at least 5 minutes earlier than the event start timestamp, such as 1705044735
parameters.help_zh: 预排队开始时间戳，至少比事件开始时间戳早5分钟，格式如：1705044735
parameters.name: pre_queue_start_time

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable random pre-queuing. Valid values:

- **on**: enabled.
- **off**: disabled
parameters.help_zh:
随机排队开关。

- **on**：开启。
- **off**：关闭
parameters.name: random_pre_queue_enable

parameters.help_en:
The language of the waiting room page. This parameter is required when the waiting room type is set to default. Valid values:

- **enus**: English.
- **zhcn**: Simplified Chinese.
- **zhhk**: Traditional Chinese
parameters.help_zh:
等候室页面的语言，当等候室类型为默认类型时，需要传入。支持以下类型：

- **enus**：英文。
- **zhcn**：中文简体。
- **zhhk**：中文繁体
parameters.name: language
